# has voice

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:hasVoice`](gmeow-hasVoice.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/hasVoice>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/music`](../../slices/music.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

Relates a musical work, expression, or segment to one of its voices. Non-functional: a work may have many voices, and a voice may participate in many works.
